description: Report on WAL behavior in the v5.11-dev build.

current_ordering.description: BEGIN → WRITE → APPLY GRAPH → APPLY FIBER → APPLY GAUGE → COMMIT
current_ordering.problem: Live mutation occurs between WRITE and COMMIT. If process dies after partial apply, recovery discards transaction but in-memory state is already partially mutated.
current_ordering.required_ordering: 1. validate transaction, 2. construct new state completely in shadow, 3. compute expected post-state hash, 4. WAL PREPARE, 5. fsync, 6. atomically swap state, 7. persist evidence/receipt, 8. WAL COMMIT, 9. fsync

wal_content.description: WAL WRITE records serialize only graph deltas (shadow_graph_state). No fiber, gauge, calibration, or model delta serialization.
wal_content.impact: Recovery can only replay graph state. Full graph+fiber+gauge transactions cannot be reconstructed from WAL.

wal_restart.description: WriteAheadLog.__init__() initializes _lsn=0 and _next_txn_id=0 without scanning existing log.
wal_restart.impact: Reopening an existing WAL can reuse txn_id=0, lsn=1 after prior transactions already used them. Recovery becomes ambiguous across runtime lifetimes.
wal_restart.required: Scan existing records on init. Set next_lsn = max_lsn + 1, next_txn_id = max_txn_id + 1.

wal_integrity_chain.description: No previous_record_hash or record_hash chain. No tamper/corruption detection.

wal_record_types.note: TX_PREPARE should contain the full transaction, not just graph state.
